props.gloss_en: that which is pure in wooden vessels is impure in metal vessels
that which is pure in metal vessels is impure in wooden vessels
unfinished wooden vessels are susceptible to impurity
flat wooden utensils are not susceptible to impurity
unfinished metal vessels are not susceptible to impurity
flat metal utensils are susceptible to impurity
a wooden vessel still awaiting smoothing, inlay, planing, grooving, or tuna-skin polish, or lacking a base, rim, or handle, is susceptible
a wooden vessel lacking the hollowing that makes it a receptacle is not susceptible
even one who hollowed a three-log capacity in a block intended for a one-kav vessel: the receptacle is incomplete, so it is not susceptible
a metal vessel still awaiting smoothing, inlay, planing, adorning, or hammering, or lacking a base, rim, or handle, is not susceptible
a metal vessel complete but lacking only a cover is susceptible
metal vessels are crafted for uses of honor, so they are not vessels until complete
metal vessels are expensive, so they are not vessels until complete
the practical difference between the two reasons is bone vessels: expensive, but not crafted for honor
the halakhic status of bone vessels with regard to impurity is like that of metal vessels
bone vessels are susceptible to ritual impurity
vessels made from goats' horns and hooves are susceptible to impurity
vessels made from the horns and hooves of other domesticated and wild animals are susceptible to impurity
vessels made from the bones of birds are not susceptible to impurity

schemas.gloss_en: 'all work of goats' (Num 31:20) includes items that come from the goats -- from the horns and from the hooves
'and ALL work' amplifies: horn and hoof vessels of other domesticated and wild animals are also susceptible
the amplification 'and all work' would extend susceptibility to vessels from birds' bones as well

grounds.gloss_en: 'עזים' -- goats: to exclude birds; vessels from birds' bones are not susceptible
